subject: Orderlink convergence: timeline and MSA/DPA dependency gaps
body:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@valencehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.reddy@valencehealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Valence MAP + timing for MSA/DPA/order form - draft attached

Hi Karthik and Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our internal MAP (Valence_MAP_v3.xlsx) that lays out the milestones we need to hit to convert the pilot into a paid production contract. High level asks:

- 12/22: legal to agree on high-level MSA redline posture
- 01/05: DPA finished and approved (we need DPA completed within 7 business days of MSA signature)
- 01/12: Order form countersigned and PO issued

We have three internal gates in procurement that are time-sensitive: security evidence (SOC2 report + dataflows), legal acceptance of liability caps, and final budget approval. I expect to get the MSA redline to you by next Wednesday.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can:
1) run a parallel review (Redwood legal + Valence legal reviewing DPA while MSA is in redline)
2) commit to a 7 business day turnaround on DPA after MSA sign (Valence needs that for our compliance calendar)

Attached: Valence_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with owners/timeslots). HubSpot link: https://hubspot.company/contacts/VAL-2026-0912

Regards,
Samir Khan
Sr. Procurement Manager, Valence Health
Attachments: Valence_MAP_v3.xlsx

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@valencehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Valence MAP + timing for MSA/DPA/order form - draft attached

Samir — thanks for the MAP and the clear milestone asks. Short answers up front: yes to parallel reviews (where practical), and we can target a 7-business-day DPA turnaround post-MSA sign provided the redlines are limited to standard DPA clauses and there are no unusual data residency/evidence asks.

Proposed coordination plan:
- Laura will lead procurement/legal orchestration on the Redwood side (owner: Laura Bennett).
- David will own acceptance criteria and pilot evidence delivery (owner: David Kim).
- Irene (legal) will triage the MSA/DPA redlines and flag anything that requires exec sign-off.

Immediate next steps:
1) Quick alignment call tomorrow 12/17 at 09:00 PT to review Valence redline and owners (can we confirm? I’ll send a calendar invite).
2) Laura to open a shared Drive folder for exchange of redlines and evidence; we’ll upload Redwood’s standard MSA + template DPA by EOD today.
3) If Valence can deliver the MSA redline by 12/23, we can aim for MSA sign by 12/30 and DPA completion by 01/08 (7 business days).

I’m cc’ing Laura, David and Irene to pick up the operational items — Laura, can you add the risk items and an escape clause recommendation (trial termination, minimal notice) to the MAP?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, Samir Khan <samir.khan@valencehealth.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@valencehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Valence MAP + timing for MSA/DPA/order form - draft attached

Samir / team — pulled a sequencing note together after scanning the MAP. Attaching a short evidence pack and an initial MSA redline extract (MSA-redline-diff.docx and redwood-procurement-evidence.pdf). Key items and recommended sequencing below.

Sequencing recommendation (minimal-risk path):
1) Parallel review: Redwood legal to review Valence MSA redline as it lands; Redwood privacy to start DPA draft in parallel using our template. This compresses elapsed time but requires close version control.
2) MSA signature first: keep MSA as the legal vehicle for commercial terms; the DPA can be linked as an annex or referenced by statement of work. That makes countersignature on the Order Form straightforward (order form becomes the money/term attachment).
3) Order form countersign: we recommend the order form be finalized and countersigned within 5 business days of MSA signature (procurement asked for 7 days but we can aim for 5 to create buffer).
4) Escape clause: include a 30-day pilot termination right in the order form with pro-rated charges — helps Valence de-risk the pilot and reduces negotiation friction on liability caps.

Dependencies & blockers:
- SOC2 attestation: we can provide our latest report and a short architecture diagram today — see attached evidence PDF.
- Liability ceilings: propose Redwood standard cap (1x fees) with carveouts for gross negligence. If Valence procurement insists on higher caps, that will likely need exec approval and will push timeline by ~3 business days.
- Data residency: if Valence requires EU-only residency for the pilot, the DPA will need additional review (add ~5 business days).

Requested deliverables from Valence before 12/23:
- MSA redline (Word)
- SOC2 contact person for evidence questions (Priya? please confirm)
- Confirmation of preferred signature path (DocuSign vs procurement portal)

I’ve uploaded the attachments to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cValenceMAP

Attachments: redwood-procurement-evidence.pdf; MSA-redline-diff.docx

Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Contracts, Redwood Inference

---
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@valencehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@valencehealth.com>, Annie Liu <annie.liu@valencehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Valence MAP + timing for MSA/DPA/order form - draft attached

Thanks Laura and Karthik — this looks good and much appreciated. A couple of small updates from procurement: our internal sign-off board pushes the PO issuance target by ~3 business days (so order form countersign moves to 01/15 worst case). Otherwise the sequencing and escape clause recommendation are fine.

Actions agreed:
- Valence will send MSA redline by 12/23.
- Redwood to upload standard MSA + template DPA to the shared Drive by EOD today (Karthik / Laura).
- Confirmed sync: 12/17 09:00 PT (please send invite).
- DocuSign acceptable as signature path.

I’ll flag Priya and Annie to follow up on SOC2 contact and procurement timeline.

Samir
Sr. Procurement Manager, Valence Health
Attachments: none
